steps.journalDescription: The guards have taken Brush to somewhere called the Pit. I must locate where the Pit is and find a way to free Brush.

The guards have taken Brush to somewhere called the Pit. I must locate where the Pit is and find a way to free Brush. Kastor has said that the other slaves speculate that the Pit lies somewhere beneath the Manse. This will make it more difficult to get Brush out, but not impossible.
I have found the Pit, but the guards have blocked the way. I will need to find another entrance.

I picked up a note left by one of the guards. It seems that there is another way to get inside the Pit: fall between the floorboards in the unfinished part of the Manse. I think I will need to begin my fall from the Manse's second floor.
I have made my way into the Pit! Now to find Brush.
I have Brush, but the door to his cell is locked. Brush has said that he saw the warden throw the key into the garbage pit near Brush's cell. I guess I'm going down there if I want to get Brush out.
I have freed Brush from the Pit.
